CustomField.description: REV-60 small-firm promo rule. Base promo written when the deal is a solo / small firm (attorney count <= Small_Firm_Attorney_Max__c) and the Opportunity has NO Group ID. Business rule 22 Jul 2026: !SREN. Deliberately WRITE-ON-BLANK-ONLY and deliberately NOT registered in allKnownBases(), so the engine can fill an empty promo but can NEVER overwrite a rep-entered code - that separation is what prevents a repeat of the 22 Jul !SREN clobber, where seeding !SREN as a team-override base made it engine-owned and non-WNS paths silently rewrote it to !SJSI. BLANK disables the rule.
CustomField.label: Small Firm Base Promo
